scripts.build: npm run build:truck && npm run build:docs
scripts.build:truck: cd systems/truck/crate && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir ../web/pkg-browser-renderer && cargo run --bin generate-schema 2>/dev/null > ../cad-schema.json
scripts.build:docs: cd systems/docs/website && bun install --silent && bun run build
scripts.test: npm run test:crate && npm run test:api
scripts.test:api: cd systems/truck/worker && bun x vitest run
scripts.test:e2e: cd systems/truck/tests && bun x playwright test
